author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Cancel pending navigation for automatic Go Home, GoHome itself, and dismiss.
author_wait_evidence.request_text:
This is good change, but it also opens a can of async worms. Original code was valid with this being synchronous.

Other navigations and other shenanigans with the pallete should cancel pending navigation explicitly, e.g.:
  - automatic Go home
  - GoHome() itself
  - dismiss

author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Address the worker page-construction path touching ExtensionHost.StatusMessages while that collection is updated on the UI scheduler, or explain why the boundary is safe.
author_wait_evidence.request_text:
TryPreparePage 
-> CommandPalettePageViewModelFactory.TryCreatePageViewModel
-> creates new specific page VM(s)
-> base PageViewModel .ctor()
-> PageViewModel.UpdateHasStatusMessage
    -> touches ExtensionHost.StatusMessages collection, that is updated from UI thread (GlobalLogPageContext captures the scheduler from the current context, bleh) from AppExtensionHost
